sources.fullCitation: Eddy Duchin and His Orchestra, vocal by Lew Sherwood. “You’re All I Need.” Words by Gus Kahn; music by Bronisław Kaper and Walter Jurmann. Victor 25029, catalogued matrix BS-89700-1; recorded in New York, 29 April 1935; issued 8 May 1935. Digital transfer published by The78Prof on YouTube.

sources.researchNote: John R. Bolig, The Victor Black Label Discography: Victor 25000, 26000, 27000 Series (2017), printed p. 5 (PDF p. 20), lists Victor 25029, BS-89700-1, Eddy Duchin and Lew Sherwood, the session on 29 April 1935 at New York studio 2, and release on 8 May 1935. The complete PDF supplied by the American Discography Project, UCSB Library, was checked; the DAHR website itself was unavailable during this review. The upload independently names Victor 25029 and the session date but displays a stylized title card, not an inspectable runout. The catalogued master and issue chronology are documented; the particular transferred copy and take are not independently established. This record does not document the publisher of the printed sheet music.
